svg.title: Change contract for an agentic capability
svg.desc: A product decision defines allowed knowledge. Context and a typed proposal lead to deterministic validation. Outputs are classified into the correct record, persisted, projected under policy, delivered through interfaces, and verified. Observed behavior then informs the next bounded change.
